name: Shodan
summary: Shodan REST API lookups: IP host details, host search and result counts, passive DNS, forward and reverse DNS, and API credit status. Needs your own Shodan API key; only Shodan Search spends query credits.
description:
Seven plugins for Shodan's paid REST API at api.shodan.io, one per endpoint, so the cheapest call that answers a question can be chosen instead of a search every time. Free, keyless IP enrichment, including Shodan's InternetDB endpoint, is in the IP Recon pack instead.

A typical loop: Shodan Count to see whether a query is worth a credit, Shodan Search to spend it, then Shodan Host and the DNS plugins to expand what came back without spending more.

## Plugins

### Shodan Host
- **Runs on:** selected IP Address nodes. Calls `/shodan/host/{ip}`.
- **Adds:** a Host node with the open ports (`exposes`); a Vulnerability node per CVE (`affected by`); reverse hostnames as Domain nodes (`resolves to`); the Autonomous System (`announced by`); a Location (`geolocated to`); and what the services present: TLS Certificates (`presents certificate`), Favicon Hashes (`has favicon`) and SSH Host Keys (`presents host key`).
- **Fills on the IP:** `country_code`, `organization`, `asn`, `reverse_dns`, `shodan_tags`, and per port `shodan_products`, `shodan_http_title` and `shodan_jarm`.
- **Limits:** at most 25 CVEs per IP, ranked by CVSS (`cvss_v3`, then `cvss`, then `cvss_v2`); the number dropped is stated in the run summary. An IP Shodan has no data for is counted as unknown, not as a failure.

### Shodan Search
- **Runs on:** a query typed in the Run dialog (no selection), with an optional page number. Calls `/shodan/host/search`.
- **Adds:** up to 100 IP Address nodes per page, each with the same nodes, edges and properties as Shodan Host.
- **Limits:** the only plugin that spends query credits: 1 credit when the query uses a filter, or for any page after the first. The summary says how many more matches exist beyond the page fetched.

### Shodan Count
- **Runs on:** a query in the Run dialog, plus facets (default `country:5,org:5,port:5,product:5`; an empty value returns the total only). Calls `/shodan/host/count`.
- **Adds:** nothing to the graph. The total and the facet breakdowns appear in the run summary.

### Shodan DNS Domain
- **Runs on:** selected Domain nodes. Calls `/dns/domain/{domain}`.
- **Adds:** subdomains as Domain nodes (`subdomain`, up to 150 per domain) and passively observed DNS records as DNS Record nodes (`has record`, up to 300 per domain) with name, value, type and TTL. A record hangs off the subdomain it belongs to when that subdomain's node was written in the same run, otherwise off the selected domain. Wildcard labels (`*`) are stripped rather than written as hosts.

### Shodan DNS Resolve
- **Runs on:** selected Domain nodes. Calls `/dns/resolve`, 25 names per request.
- **Adds:** the IP Address each name points at, with a `resolves to` edge from the domain.

### Shodan DNS Reverse
- **Runs on:** selected IP Address nodes. Calls `/dns/reverse`, 25 addresses per request.
- **Adds:** a Domain node per PTR hostname (`resolves to`, from the IP), and writes the first hostname to the IP's `reverse_dns`.

### Shodan API Status
- **Runs on:** nothing; no selection needed. Calls `/api-info`.
- **Adds:** nothing to the graph. Reports the key's plan, remaining query and scan credits, and monitored IPs in the run summary.

## How results meet other packs

Node and edge shapes match the free packs, so a fact reads the same whichever plugin wrote it: open ports, CVEs and reverse hostnames as in IP Recon's Shodan InternetDB; forward resolution and DNS records as in Domain Recon's DNS Lookup; the AS as in IP Intelligence; the location as in IP Recon's IP Geolocation; subdomains as in Domain Recon's Certificate Transparency.

- A certificate is identified by its SHA-256 fingerprint, a favicon by Shodan's MMH3 value, and an SSH host key by the SHA-256 of the key itself (not Shodan's MD5 `ssh.fingerprint`). The same one written by Censys, VirusTotal or Web Recon becomes one node.
- A certificate serial is written only when Shodan's number for it is exact; a 128-bit serial arrives rounded and is left for VirusTotal or Censys to fill.
- The Autonomous System node carries only the ASN. Shodan's country is where the IP geolocates, not where the AS is registered.
- A Location node is created only for a city or a region, never for a bare country.
- Product and version strings, Shodan tags, HTTP titles and JARM hashes are properties on the IP, not nodes: they are values to feed back into Shodan Search, and as nodes they would join millions of unrelated hosts. The registrable `domains` list of a host response is not written; the hostnames are.

## Requirements

- A Shodan account and its API key. Every plugin declares an `api_key` setting, but all seven share one stored value, so it is entered once: in any plugin's Settings in the Run plugins dialog, or under Settings → Keys & Secrets. It is kept encrypted in the OS keychain on desktop, or for the session in a browser.
- Runs in the web app and on desktop.

## Cost and limits

- Only Shodan Search spends query credits. This was measured against a live key by reading `/api-info` before and after each call. Shodan Count and Shodan API Status are the free ways to check before spending.
- A `429` response gets one retry, after `Retry-After` when Shodan sends it, otherwise after 2 seconds.
- Plugins that loop over a selection wait about 350 ms between calls.
- A rejected key (`401`) ends the run with a message saying so, instead of counting every remaining item as a failure.
- Caps: 100 results per Search page, 25 CVEs per host, 150 subdomains and 300 DNS records per domain, 25 per-port entries in each `shodan_*` property.

## What it contacts

Only `https://api.shodan.io`. Shodan receives every IP address, domain and query sent, together with the API key, which travels as Shodan's `?key=` query parameter (the REST API has no header option). The pack never connects to a target itself; every lookup is a request to Shodan.

At install, Shodan Host's network permission (`https://api.shodan.io/shodan/host`) also covers `/shodan/host/search` and `/shodan/host/count`, because the permission is a path prefix.

## Data and licences

All results are Shodan's data, returned under the analyst's own Shodan account: https://www.shodan.io/

## Source

https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-shodan (Apache-2.0)

`dist/pack.mjs` is hand-written and is the source; there is no build step. `plugins/shodan.manifest.json` is generated from it with `node gen-manifest.mjs`, and `node test-plugin.mjs` runs the functional tests against a mocked graph and network.

plugins.name: Shodan Host
plugins.description: Looks up each selected IP Address in Shodan and creates its Host with open ports ("exposes"), CVEs as Vulnerability nodes ("affected by", up to 25 per IP, highest CVSS first), reverse hostnames as Domain nodes ("resolves to"), its Autonomous System ("announced by"), Location ("geolocated to"), and what its services present: TLS Certificates ("presents certificate"), Favicon Hashes ("has favicon") and SSH Host Keys ("presents host key"). Fills the IP's country_code, organization, asn and reverse_dns, plus shodan_tags and, per port, shodan_products, shodan_http_title and shodan_jarm. Does not spend a query credit; needs a Shodan API key.

network.purpose: Look up each selected IP address's host details on Shodan.

plugins.name: Shodan Search
plugins.description: Runs a Shodan host search from a query in the Run dialog (no selection) and creates up to 100 matching IP Address nodes per page, each with its Host ("exposes"), CVEs as Vulnerability nodes ("affected by", up to 25 per IP), hostnames as Domain nodes ("resolves to"), Autonomous System ("announced by"), Location ("geolocated to"), TLS Certificates ("presents certificate"), Favicon Hashes ("has favicon") and SSH Host Keys ("presents host key"), with shodan_tags and, per port, shodan_products, shodan_http_title and shodan_jarm on the IP. Spends 1 query credit when the query uses a filter or for any page after the first; needs a Shodan API key.

query.title: Query
query.description: Shodan search query, e.g. org:"Example Corp", hostname:example.com or product:nginx port:443.

page.title: Page
page.description: Results page to fetch, 100 results per page (default 1). Each page is a separate search and can spend a query credit.

network.purpose: Search Shodan for hosts matching the query.

plugins.name: Shodan Count
plugins.description: Counts the hosts matching a Shodan search query from the Run dialog (no selection) and reports the total and facet breakdowns (default: country, org, port, product) in the run summary; creates no nodes. Does not spend a query credit; needs a Shodan API key.

query.title: Query
query.description: Shodan search query, e.g. org:"Example Corp" or product:nginx country:KR.

facets.title: Facets
facets.description: Comma-separated facet:count pairs; country:5,org:5,port:5,product:5 if not given. An empty string returns the total only.

network.purpose: Count the hosts matching a query on Shodan.

plugins.name: Shodan DNS Domain
plugins.description: Fetches Shodan's passively observed DNS data for each selected Domain: subdomains become Domain nodes ("subdomain", up to 150 per domain) and DNS records become DNS Record nodes ("has record", up to 300 per domain). Does not spend a query credit; needs a Shodan API key.

network.purpose: Fetch a domain's known subdomains and passively-observed DNS records.

plugins.name: Shodan DNS Resolve
plugins.description: Resolves each selected Domain to its IP address through Shodan, creating an IP Address node with a "resolves to" edge from the domain. Does not spend a query credit; needs a Shodan API key.

plugins.name: Shodan DNS Reverse
plugins.description: Looks up the PTR hostnames of each selected IP Address through Shodan, creating a Domain node per hostname with a "resolves to" edge from the IP, and writes the first hostname to the IP's reverse_dns. Does not spend a query credit; needs a Shodan API key.

network.purpose: Look up the PTR hostnames for IP addresses.

plugins.name: Shodan API Status
plugins.description: Reports the configured Shodan key's plan and remaining query and scan credits in the run summary; runs without a selection and creates no nodes. Does not spend a credit; needs a Shodan API key.

network.purpose: Check the configured key's plan and remaining credits.
